examples.body: 已確認寄信重試條件，請協助 review。

CardOrder.description: A lane's manual card order. Recorded per lane rather than per card because one drag renumbers every card in up to two lanes.

MilestoneSyncAction.description: The full milestone calendar. Replaced wholesale: the set is small, changes rarely, and per-row keying would need delete/upsert pairs on every rename.

examples.title: Validation failed
examples.detail: One or more request fields are invalid.

syncId.description: Monotonic checkpoint. Gapless and issued in commit order.

SyncAction.description: One recorded change. Payloads are full snapshots, so applying the same action twice is a no-op and the newest action for an entity subsumes every earlier one.

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint reached. Store it and send it back as `since` next time.

hasMore.description: More actions remain past this batch; request again from the new checkpoint.
